comment: 65yo male, three stacked modifiable-risk RFs concurrently: (1) active current smoker 30+ pack-years (~1 ppd since age 25), (2) class 2 obesity BMI 38 kg/m² (weight 118 kg, height 176 cm), (3) documented elevated residential radon 6.8 pCi/L (above EPA 4 pCi/L action threshold) in granite-bedrock high-risk geographic region. No current cancer diagnosis. Multi-RF stacking validates the universal-multi-exposure prevention pathway. Engine fires THREE upstream RFs concurrently: (a) RF-LIFESTYLE-TOBACCO-CANCER-PREVENTION (any_of: tobacco_status_current_smoker:true OR tobacco_pack_years_ge_20:true) → broad tobacco-attributable cancer surveillance (NSCLC/SCLC/UROTHELIAL/PDAC/HCC/AML/H&N/cervical); (b) RF-LIFESTYLE-OBESITY-CANCER-PREVENTION (any_of: bmi_ge_30:true OR bmi_ge_35:true) → 13-cancer obesity-attributable surveillance (post-menopausal breast / endometrial / CRC / esoph adenoCa / gastric cardia / HCC / RCC / ovarian / PDAC / gallbladder / MM / meningioma / thyroid); (c) RF-RADON-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION (any_of: residential_radon_exposure_ge_4_pci_per_l:true OR residential_radon_exposure_documented_high_with_smoking_hx:true) → lung-cancer-specific surveillance with synergistic smoking-radon interaction (~10-25x background in heavy-exposed smokers). Routes to multi-track PreventionPlan: standard = combined structured smoking cessation (combined behavioural + varenicline/bupropion/NRT) + structured weight-loss intervention (registered-dietitian + structured physical activity ± GLP-1RA if metabolic indications) + radon mitigation (sub-slab depressurization + home ventilation) + annual LDCT per USPSTF (patient eligible: age 65 / ≥20 pack-y / current smoker) + USPSTF-cadence CRC + cardiovascular co-management; alternative = single-highest-yield modality (cessation amplification + LDCT) and observation on remaining axes. Distinct from existing patient_multiple_exposures_smoker_radon.json (smoker+radon only; this case adds obesity dimension). Validates v0.3 multi-RF universal-exposure stacking pilot.
